mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy benefits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 10.0% within a 3-month window signals severe labor market distress, triggering immediate positive equity returns as investors anticipate aggressive fiscal stimulus over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below 400,000 million and 900,000 units respectively indicate broad demand contraction, prompting policy intervention that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS < 400000 and HOUST < 900000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary easing (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over 20 trading days as policy accommodation boosts risk appetite and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 90.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering positive equity returns as the market prices in policy support over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) falling below 400,000 million dollars in a single month indicates acute demand shock, generating immediate positive equity returns as investors anticipate swift policy response over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as policy responses materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines relative to 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0%) signal dual economic crisis, triggering aggressive policy responses that produce positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% and UNRATE > 10.0%.
